title: Smile (2022 film) — Why You Feel It, And Who Decided #Shorts
description:
Freud is not dead; he is simply no longer allowed to be the whole answer. Smile is a 2022 American supernatural psychological horror film written and directed by Parker Finn, in his feature directorial debut. A follow-up to Finn's short film Laura Hasn't Slept (2020), it stars Sosie Bacon as a therapist who witnesses the bizarre suicide of a patient, then becomes overwhelmed with increasingly disturbing visions that lead her to believe she is experiencing something supernatural.

The nihilist does not deny Smile (2022 film) — he only refuses to flatter it. At the 51st Saturn Awards, the film was nominated for Best Horror Film. Laura Hasn't Slept was written and directed by Parker Finn in 2019, and later debuted at South by Southwest in 2020.
